english.title: Remove safety measures re street works - New Road and Street Works Act 1991
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful authority or excuse, removed any

(A)_[fence]_
(B)_[barrier]_
(C)_[traffic sign]_
(D)_[light]_

erected or placed in pursuance of section 65(1) or 65(2) of the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991
english.legislation: Contrary to section 65(6)(a) of the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991.

english.notes:
(i) See also H1025, H1026, H1027, H1028 and H1062.
(ii) The penalty for this offence was raised to level five as from 01/04/08 by section 40 of and Schedule 1 to the Traffic Management Act 2004.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without lawful authority or excuse, removed any

(A)_[fence]_
(B)_[barrier]_
(C)_[traffic sign]_
(D)_[light]_

erected or placed in pursuance of section 65(1) or 65(2) of the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
